## Summary
2026-09-24: live since 1 August 2026; hypercare ended 30 September. Main open problem: members cannot see their past season tickets or loyalty points, which matters for the away ballot on 20 October.

## Facts
- Ground: Millbrook Lane, capacity 12,800.
- Ticket office manager: [[Lucy Ashdown]]. Our account manager: [[Ellie Thornbury]].
- 18,100 members imported in July; tiers mapped to `VR-GOLD`, `VR-SILVER`, `VR-JUNIOR`.
- Loyalty points decide priority for away tickets.
